events.title: The All Hands demo is live!
events.summary: Our free demo is available now on Steam! Defend your HQ in an incremental tower defence game where you build barriers, reshape terrain, and redirect crowds of furious customers. Give it a try and let us know what you think in the comments or Steam discussions. If you enjoy it, please wishlist the full game! Download the demo and wishlist All Hands: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4867340/All_Hands/ Thanks for playing, Lion & Otter Studios

events.title: Playtest closed. Thank you for playing!
events.summary: The All Hands playtest has now closed. Thanks to everyone who participated and shared feedback. You've given us great suggestions and helped identify what needs improving. A demo with improvements informed by your feedback is coming soon. We look forward to sharing it with you!

events.title: Playtest Update: corporate disasters and productivity targets
events.summary: More corporate problems for the horde Since Friday's Shape the Horde update, several more Playtest builds have landed. This post covers only what has changed since those patch notes. New threats and questionable opportunities The Change Manager is a new horde specialist that commandeers a large group, rallies it on a reachable flank, then sends it back toward HQ from a new angle. events.title: All Hands Playtest Update: Shape the Horde
events.summary: This is a big Playtest update focused on giving you more ways to shape the horde, clearer battlefield information, and a much friendlier first shift. Greenfield is now an interaction playground Greenfield maps now contain ten kinds of mechanical rural landmarks: Duck ponds Irrigation ditches Blackberry brambles Compost pits Cattle paddocks Manure lagoons Pumpkin patches Apiaries Topiary mazes Orchard presses These landmarks can slow, redirect, bunch, trap, launch, or otherwise interfere with zom

events.title: You could design All Hands’ 39th turret
events.summary: You could help design the next turret in All Hands!We’ve built 38 turrets already. Now we’re asking Reddit to pitch turret #39. Give it a name and tell us what it does. One sentence is enough, and sketches are welcome.The most-upvoted eligible top-level comment at 12:00 UTC on 25 August will get its suggestion implemented in All Hands before the demo goes live. We’ll balance it for the game and adapt anything impossible or too close to an existing turret.Join the competition on Reddit: Submit yo
